title: Counting below a threshold by a filter
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $l$ be a finite list in $\alpha$, and let $x,y\in\alpha$ with $x<y$. The number of entries of $l$ strictly less than $y$ equals the number of entries strictly greater than $x$ and strictly less than $y$, plus the number of entries less than or equal to $x$.
